"position": "0,0", "size": "0,0"}, "children": null, "text": null}, {"tag": "applet", "attrs": {"type": "onLayoutFinish"}, "children": null, "text": "from enigma import ePoint, eSize, getDesktop, gRGB, BT_ALPHABLEND
from Components.Label import Label
from Components.Pixmap import Pixmap
from Tools.Directories import resolveFilename, SCOPE_CURRENT_SKIN
from Tools.LoadPixmap import LoadPixmap
from skin import parseRadius, parseColor
if self.timerRunning:
 titleheight = 0
else:
 titleheight = 0

orgwidth = self.instance.size().width()
orgheight = self.instance.size().height()
orgpos = self.instance.position()
textsize = self["text"].getSize()
textsize = (textsize[0] + 76, textsize[1])
wsizex = textsize[0] + 140
if (75 + textsize[1]) > 180:
 wsizey = textsize[1] + 80 + 84
else:
 wsizey = 180 + 96
lenlist = len(self.list)*45
if (lenlist > 380):
 lenlist = 380
if (180 > wsizey):
 wsizey = 180

wsizey += lenlist + 25

if (420 > wsizex):
 wsizex = 420
listwidth = self.getListWidth() + 20
if (listwidth > 1280):
 listwidth = 1280
if (listwidth > wsizex):
 wsizex = listwidth
wsize = (wsizex, wsizey + titleheight)
self.instance.resize(eSize(*wsize))
self["text"].instance.move(ePoint(130, 75 + titleheight))
self["text"].instance.resize(eSize(*textsize))
if "ErrorPixmap" in self:
 self["ErrorPixmap"].instance.move(ePoint(30, 80 + titleheight))
 self["ErrorPixmap"].instance.resize(eSize(80,80))
if "WarningPixmap" in self:
 self["WarningPixmap"].instance.move(ePoint(30, 80 + titleheight))

 self["QuestionPixmap"].instance.resize(eSize(80,80))
if "InfoPixmap" in self:
 self["InfoPixmap"].instance.move(ePoint(30, 80 + titleheight))
 self["InfoPixmap"].instance.resize(eSize(80,80))
if "icon" in self:
 self["icon"].instance.move(ePoint(30, 80 + titleheight))
 self["icon"].instance.resize(eSize(80,80))
if self.type == self.TYPE_YESNO:
 listsize = (wsizex-20, lenlist)
 self["list"].instance.move(ePoint(10, wsizey - lenlist + titleheight - 94 - 3))
 self["list"].instance.resize(eSize(*listsize))
newwidth = wsize[0]
self.instance.move(ePoint(orgpos.x() + (orgwidth - newwidth) // 2, orgpos.y() + (orgheight - wsizey) // 2))"}, {"tag": "applet", "attrs": {"type": "onLayoutFinish"}, "children": null, "text": "from enigma import ePoint, eSize

wsizex = self.instance.size().width()
wsizey = self.instance.size().height() - 20
radiusBLayer, edgeValueBLayer = parseRadius("16")
radiusTLayer, edgeValueTLayer = parseRadius("14")
self["blayer"] = Label()
self["blayer"].GUIcreate(self.instance)
self["blayer"].instance.setCornerRadius(radiusBLayer, edgeValueBLayer)
self["blayer"].instance.resize(eSize(wsizex, wsizey))
self["blayer"].instance.setBackgroundColor(parseColor("md_surface_container_high"))
self["blayer"].instance.move(ePoint(0, 0))

self["tlayer"] = Label()

self["tlayer"].instance.resize(eSize(wsizex - 4, wsizey - 47 - 62))

self["tlayer"].instance.move(ePoint(2, 47))
